On the Galápagos Islands, young marine iguanas must escape an onslaught of deadly racer snakes the moment they hatch from the sand.

programme.title: Planet Earth II

programme.desc: By pushing themselves and their bodies to the limit, mammals have found remarkable ways to survive in the hottest places on earth. In baking deserts, harsh dry spiny forests, barren desolate salt pans and even bush fires, mammals beat the heat.

programme.title: Mammals

programme.title: Planet Earth II
programme.desc: Remote islands offer sanctuary for some of the planet's strangest and rarest creatures. The rare pygmy three-toed sloth enjoys a peaceful existence on an idyllic Caribbean island, while nesting albatross thrive in predator-free isolation. However, island life always comes at a cost. On the Galápagos Islands, young marine iguanas must escape an onslaught of deadly racer snakes the moment they hatch from the sand.

programme.title: Planet Earth II
programme.desc: The great mountain ranges are some of the planet's most spectacular landscapes, but they are unforgiving places to live in. Only few pioneering animals have what it takes to endure at extreme altitude. Mountain animals are also amongst the most elusive in the world, yet this film provides unique and intimate glimpses into their secretive lives. Witness the moment four snow leopards come together when a mother and cub become trapped between two rival males.

While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: When one-time rock hopeful Robbie is jilted at the altar, he vents his bitterness in song, even when singing at other people's weddings. Only true love can redeem the broken-hearted songster but fortunately, he's about to meet a woman who will spin him right round (like a record).

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.

programme.title: All Living Things

programme.title: The Man in the Mirror

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.sub-title: The Case of the French Interpreter
programme.desc: Holmes and Watson try to rescue a prisoner.

programme.title: Our Man in Havana
programme.desc: A wry adaptation of Graham Greene's novel. After being recruited as a British agent in Havana, a vacuum-cleaner salesman begins to fabricate information to earn extra cash. The chief of police grows suspicious of his actions and spies on him - unaware that he too is being spied upon by the salesman.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: The quiet of an idyllic port town is shattered when a body is found on the beach.

programme.title: IWM: Salvage with a Smile
programme.desc: Second World comedy short explaining the value of salvage with Kathleen Harrison and Ronald Shiner.

programme.title: Reach for the Sky
programme.desc: The true story of WWII fighter pilot ace Douglas Bader, who lost both legs in a flying accident, but confounded both his doctor's expectations and those of the RAF, by learning to walk in time to marry sweetheart Thelma and to pass flying school. Bader was shot down over France and captured. His indefatigable resolve saw him try to escape so often, and eventually he was confined to Colditz until the end of the war.
